requested_result: Diagnose distinct unresolved harmful lesson transfer; change and evaluate only where supported, otherwise retain baseline with bounded evidence.

scope_basis.quote: Investigate whether actual retained lessons cause harmful transfer under changed tools, goals or preconditions. If the opportunity is already adequately handled, demonstrate that with evidence and retain baseline; no forced edit or manufactured comparison.

required_checks.description: Classify retained-lesson leads and whether new applicability headroom exists.
Inspect existing actual executions and delivered lessons/decisions without repeating settled trials.
Retain runtime and historical evidence absent a justified candidate.
